title: Post-fire debris-flow hazard assessment summary
description: A post-wildfire debris-flow hazard assessment summary in the style of a geological survey: the burn area, the fire and its containment, the storm intensities assessed (for example 15-minute rainfall rates), and for each the percent of drainage basins with a high likelihood of a debris flow and the expected volume class. It states that the map is for planning and is not a forecast of a flow on a given day.

examples: 38,400 acres burned; 214 drainage basins and 62 road segments assessed

likelihood.description: Basins with high likelihood of a debris flow

examples: Debris flows could be triggered by short, intense rain over the burned area. Basins above the highway and the town of Haldane have the highest hazard.
The hazard map is guidance for planning. It does not forecast a debris flow on any given day.
